hypothesis: The v295 all-history contextual exact-top3 expert already benefits from pairwise and current-meet state, but it does not explicitly encode each racer's strictly-prior ability conditional on official actual course. Appending the previously frozen five-dimensional hierarchical racer-course state may add a distinct long-horizon interaction without changing the successful v295 structure.

base_model.rule: retain all v295 raw, official-course, pairwise tau20, seven-day meet, model, fold, and gamma-bound definitions unchanged

dynamic_racer_course.ordering: build every feature for a race_date before applying any result update from that date
dynamic_racer_course.course_missing: all dynamic course features zero and no racer-course update; overall racer state still updates after the date

training.fold_rows: all strictly-prior raw races for each fold
training.screen_rows: fixed candidate acceleration indices after full-series history construction
stages: second among five conditioned on first
third among four conditioned on first and second

anchoring.optimizer: deterministic bounded scalar exact-top3 logloss minimization

promotion_requires: v295 delta below zero, race-date bootstrap CI95 upper below zero, and v295 child-family Holm p below 0.05
